switcher.title: Your workspaces
switcher.note: Switching the workspace switches the calendar, clients and settings too.

shell.closed: This section is closed to you

profile.title: My profile
profile.lead: Your {brand} account — the same in every workspace
profile.photoTooBig: {file} is {size} MB. Photos can be up to {max} MB.
profile.photoWrongType: {file} isn’t a photo. Use JPG or PNG.
profile.nameHint: Your teams see you by this name.
profile.phoneHint: You log in to {app} and {client} with this number. To change it, confirm the new number with a code.
profile.phoneHintFixed: You log in to {app} and {client} with this number.
profile.oldWorks: Until the new number is verified you can log in with the old one.
profile.taken: This number is used by another account
profile.ownerCantLeave: You’re the owner of {business}, so you can’t leave it. To close this workspace, contact {brand}.

leave.title: Leave {business}?
leave.text: You’ll stop seeing its calendar. Your bookings and requests stay with the business — the owner will choose who takes them.

login.title: Log in to {app}
login.lead: Enter your phone number — we’ll show you a 4-digit code. No password needed.
login.phoneHint: If you already book on {brand} as a client, use that number — one account works for both.
login.phoneHintDemo: Use the same made-up number on the {brand} site and here — one account works for both.
login.incomplete: The number is incomplete — it needs {digits} digits.
login.notMobile: Codes go to mobile numbers only. Enter a number starting with {starts}.
login.tooManyCodes: Too many codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.codeHint: It checks itself after the 4th digit.
login.codeExpired: The old code no longer works.
login.wrongCode: Wrong code. {left, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
login.locked: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

identity.title: Is this you, {name}?
identity.lead: This number’s account hasn’t been used for 6 months. Numbers sometimes pass to someone new, so we ask before you go in.
identity.ownsWorkspace: This account owns a business on {brand}, so it can’t start afresh here. Contact {brand} to sort out the number.

name.title: What’s your name?
name.lead: Your number is verified. Enter your name for your {brand} account — your team will see you by this name.

invite.title: {business} invites you to the team
invite.as: As {level, select, admin {an Admin} other {a Specialist}}
invite.admin1: You’ll see every calendar, booking and client
invite.admin2: You can answer requests and reply to reviews
invite.admin3: You can change services, prices and settings
invite.specialist1: You’ll see your own calendar and bookings
invite.specialist2: You can answer your own requests
invite.specialist3: You’ll see your own clients and earnings
invite.declineLead: {name} will be told. To join later you’ll need a new invite.
invite.declineLeadNobody: The business will be told. To join later you’ll need a new invite.

expired.title: The invite has expired
expired.lead: Each invite works for {days} days. The invite {business} sent on {sent} ended on {ended}.
expired.note: Ask the owner to send it again — the new invite will appear here.

empty.title: You don’t have a workspace yet
empty.lead: Open your business: calendar, online booking and a client list — free.
empty.note: Work at a business? Ask the owner to send an invite to your phone number — it will appear here.

opening.title: Opening {business}…
opening.one: We open the workspace you used last.
opening.many: You have {count} workspaces. We open the one you used last; pick another at the top of the left menu.

login.demoNote: This is a demo of {brand}: the sign-in code shows here instead of an SMS. Use a made-up number, and don’t type in real people’s names or numbers.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: The address may have a typo, or the page has moved.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.lead: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.

setup.title: Set up your business
setup.caption: 8 steps · about 5 minutes · free
setup.laterNote: Saves this step. Log in again and setup reopens right here.
setup.laterSaved: Saved. Log in again with {phone} and setup reopens at “{step}”.

business.title: About your business
business.lead: Clients find you by this name and category. The category also suggests starter services.
business.leadMore: Each workspace is one business at one address: its own calendar, team, clients and settings. Your {brand} account stays the same, and you’ll be the owner of the new business.
business.name: Business name
business.nameLong: Too long: up to {max, number} characters.
business.hintLong: Shorten the business name to {max, number} characters.

category.label: Category
category.searchPlaceholder: Search, for example: nails, dentist, tutor
category.noneText: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try another word, or tell us what you do.

address.title: Where will clients find you?
address.lead: Search for the address, then fine-tune the pin on the map. Clients use this pin to find their way.

hours.title: Your hours
hours.lead: Clients can book only within these hours. You’ll add staff shifts later.

services.title: Your services
services.lead: Pick from the ready list, then adjust each name, duration and price to suit you.

team.title: Who do you work with?
team.lead: With a team, each specialist gets their own calendar and clients can pick who they book with.

rules.title: How should bookings arrive?
rules.lead: Confirm each new online booking yourself, or accept it at once.

done.title: {name} is ready!
done.lead: Add bookings that come by phone or walk-in. Online booking opens after the review.

signedOut.lead: Setting up a business starts with your phone number. Log in or sign up first.
